'''Seikosha''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Breago system/Legends|Breago system]] which remained neutral during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
Seikosha was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]], appearing to be an unimpressive green-brown mudball from space. A [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] world of choking [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] foliage, Seikosha had a tumultuous [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of near-legendary violent weather, with thunderstorms, downpours, and massive, steel-grey storm clouds cloaking the entire planet. These lightning storms caused electrical interference with [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. The jungles were thick and muddy, with broad-leafed [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] patches. [[Sid'Han]] dwelt in muddy patches, lying in wait for prey.<ref name="Politics" />

[[Cairn (city)|Cairn]], seemingly the planet's only major [[City/Legends|city]], was located in the middle of the jungle, and featured seedy bars, like the [[Event Horizon (Seikosha)|Event Horizon]], and impromptu landing fields.<ref name="Politics" />

==History==
An undeveloped world, Seikosha was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of  the [[Seikoshan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It also hosted a variety of offworld colonists. The natives barely entered into production and manufacturing of basic goods, requiring the import of high-tech items such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and weapons. Cairn city utilized local [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] variants known as [[Cryospac-90 Boghopper|bog-hoppers]].<ref name="Politics" />

It maintained neutrality during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], despite its area of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] being actively contested in the conflict. Over the space of several [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the planet became a haven for a large number of criminals. A group of Seikoshan rebels, despising the despoilment of their planet and the mistreatment of their people by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], began using unfamiliar technologies and violent methods in an effort to remove the newcomers, with the help of New Republic [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Kade Darven]].<ref name="Politics" />

During this period, [[Simms Jonndril]] hired a group of individuals to transport a cargo of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]&mdash;including [[R1-T4]]&mdash;from New Republic space to the Seikoshan [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Janelle Serap]]. After pursuit through Seikosha's storms by four [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] owned by Serap's competitor, [[Lydenn Carridon]], the travelers met with [[Jasta Finn]] at Serap's landing strip. They were sent to meet with [[Tannor Nuum]] in the Event Horizon [[cantina]] for payment and delivery, but encountered [[Chiron Drebbick]], an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] infiltration [[Agent/Legends|agent]] posing as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to Carridon, instead, and were forced to fight his [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] thugs. Captured by Drebbik, the group was stranded in the jungle, though Carridon's Z-95s shot down Drebbik's commandeered vessel, causing it to crash in the jungle. Attacked by a [[Sid'Han]], the group was brought to the [[Seikoshan rebel camp]] and met Kade Darven, leading to confrontations with their foes in the jungle.<ref name="Politics" />
